svg.title: Keep an independent point of comparison.
svg.desc: Illustrative four-record export matches a separately retained checkpoint at record three after signature verification. A two-record export is too short. A matching boundary does not replace checking every event.

g.aria-label: A longer journal can match an earlier checkpoint.
Compare the retained boundary, not just the newest head hash.
A 2-record export fails: 2 < 3. The verifier also checks every supplied record.
